card.name: "And" after removing from refrigerator
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "remove [product] from the refrigerator" in injection preparation instructions. The next words are usually "allow it to reach room temperature".

modes.label: Refrigerator then warm up
modes.description: "and" joins taking a product out of the refrigerator with the instruction to let it reach room temperature.
modes.example: Prior to use, remove ENSPRYNG from the refrigerator<< and>> allow it to sit at room temperature outside
